subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should hook installation enforce a 1 MiB regular-file-only contract for `HOOK.md`?
rationale: The implementation safely closes the memory-exhaustion path, but it intentionally tightens accepted input beyond any currently documented or shipped size limit.

options.title: Accept the hardened contract
options.body: Treat `HOOK.md` as small regular-file metadata and adopt the proposed 1 MiB ceiling.

options.title: Choose a different shared ceiling
options.body: Raise or centralize the limit if maintainers expect legitimate hook documentation above 1 MiB.

recommendation.title: Accept the hardened contract
recommendation.body: Treat `HOOK.md` as small regular-file metadata and adopt the proposed 1 MiB ceiling.
